Scope and limits

  • Mounted sources: copied baseline .local/cobranza-layout-before/cuentas-destino.tsx and current production artifacts/mariana-textil/src/pages/caja/cuentas-destino.tsx.
  • Browser automation: Playwright Chromium at 1280×1100 and 402×874; comparison URL on and off.

  • All browser API and external traffic is denied; the production data hook is replaced only inside this harness.
  • CSS evidence uses the owner stylesheet and Tailwind @source scan entries for both production and baseline trees.
